purpose: Identify someone or something as outstanding within a group.
keywords: Group noun + きっての + N
She is the town’s foremost cook.
My older brother is the biggest reader in the family.
That is one of the prefecture’s outstanding sights.
formation: Group noun + きっての + N
restrictions: Often praises a specialist or prominent characteristic.
mistake: The first noun defines the group, not the quality.
